newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia May house material prices rise 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australia May house material prices rise 0.2 pct.

text.p: Australian house building materials rose 0.2 percent in May from the previous month and were 1.2 percent higher than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Other building materials were unchanged in the month and were 0.9 percent higher than a year earlier.

The bureau said the increase in housing materials was mainly due to higher prices for clay bricks and ready mixed concrete. These were slightly offset by price falls for cupboards and fittings, it said.
The index has risen every month so far this calendar year.
The only significant price movement in non-housing materials was an increase in the price of reinforcing steel bars, the bureau said.
